# pve_node_disk_lvmthin (Resource)

Manages an LVM thinpool on a Proxmox VE node. PVE does not support in-place thinpool reconfigure, so any non-key attribute change forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_disk_lvmthin" "data" {
  node           = "pve1"
  name           = "data"
  device         = "/dev/sdb"
  add_storage    = true
  cleanup_config = true
  cleanup_disks  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) The block device to create the thinpool on (e.g. `/dev/sdb`).
- `name` (String) Thinpool name. Also the storage identifier PVE uses when `add_storage` is enabled.
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Also create a storage entry backed by the thinpool in PVE.
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) When deleting the thinpool, also remove the storage entry PVE created when `add_storage=true` was set. Defaults to `true`.
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) When deleting the thinpool, also wipe the underlying disk so it can be repurposed. Defaults to `true`; set to `false` to keep the disk for inspection.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pve_node_disk_lvmthin.data pve1:data
```
